title: Opening my own café
instructions: Mehmet kendi kafesini nasıl açtığını anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; sayıları ve olayların sırasını karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Five years ago, I decided to open my own café. Before that, I worked in an office for ten years, and I was bored.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Finding the right place was difficult. I looked at more than twenty buildings before I found a small shop near the university.

script.speaker: s
script.text: At first, business was slow. Some days, only ten customers came in.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Then I had an idea. I started selling cheap breakfast for students, and I put free Wi-Fi in the café.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Soon, students started coming every day to study and meet friends.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Now I have six people working for me, and last year I opened a second café in the city centre.

script.speaker: s
script.text: It's hard work. I often work twelve hours a day. But I've never been happier.

script.speaker: s
script.text: My advice? Don't be afraid to try something new.
